address: 91 Nanxin Road, Gusu, Suzhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: While the majority of diners love the traditional décor of this famous restaurant, its authentic flavours and generous portions at sensible prices find favour with all. Suzhou classic sautéed river shrimps seduce with natural umami and springy texture. Pork belly steeped in wine lees marinade boasts intoxicating aromas and melt-in-the-mouth, silky flesh. Its location near waterside Shantang Street is a hit at weekends.
